devicesHint: One row per Sonoff switch. The name becomes the object-tree folder (ewelink.0.<name>.control.power). Devices fetched from your eWeLink account need only their device ID: their IP address is learned from their network announcements, and their key is stored encrypted. For a switch in DIY mode, enter its IP address; its device ID is optional.
Name: Name
pollIntervalHelp: How often each device is asked for its switch state (5-3600 s)
accountHint: Switches in the normal eWeLink LAN control mode need a device key, which only the eWeLink cloud knows. To fetch the keys once: create an app in the eWeLink developer centre (dev.ewelink.cc) with the redirect URL below, enter its App ID and App Secret, click "Sign in with eWeLink" and sign in with your eWeLink account. The browser then opens the redirect URL, which may show an error page: copy the complete address from the address bar into the field below and click "Fetch devices" within a few minutes. The adapter controls the switches over the local network only; it does not stay connected to the cloud.
redirectUrlHelp: Must be exactly the redirect URL registered for the app
signInAddressHelp: The complete address the browser shows after signing in, containing code= and region=
